section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a study that investigated the association between online interpersonal sexual objectification (OISO) experiences and intuitive eating in 1152 Chinese adolescent girls. The study also examined the mediating roles of broad conceptualization of beauty and body appreciation. Results indicated a negative association of OISO experiences with broad conceptualization of beauty and intuitive eating, with mediation through beauty conceptualization and body appreciation.
